title: Choose the visual world for Stefano's site
question: The roll dealt the press sheet. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Press Check
options.lineage: offset press sheets on the proofing table
options.thesis: The portfolio is a press sheet waiting for your OK: Stefano's work printed plate by plate.
options.viewport: Full-bleed sheet: STEFANO DOKO prints in four plates inside crop marks, a colour bar runs along the foot, and an 'OK to print' rubber stamp is the button to write to him.
options.risk: Four process inks can turn into a rainbow; the ink laws below keep one plate in charge.

raised.raise: Ink laws: cyan is anything you can click, magenta what you are touching, yellow only highlights, black carries the text.
The colour bar along the sheet's foot is the page's progress: one lit patch marks where you are.
Only the thing in motion gets all four inks; everything at rest sits in black.
Sections are press stages (plate, proof, press, fold) with named, linkable states.
The name lockup must read from billboard to favicon; the stamp mark is tested at 16px.

options.label: Shop Fronts
options.lineage: Albanian street fascias, lightboxes and painted signs
options.thesis: The portfolio as a street of shop fronts: type your business name and see it on a sign.
options.viewport: A night street of lit fascias; the middle sign reads STEFANO DOKO and a blank sign waits for the visitor's own business name.
options.risk: Familiar: the type-your-name-on-a-sign demo is a known trick, and street signage can read cheap.

options.label: Penny Broadside
options.thesis: Each project as the day's broadside: shouting wood type, an engraved band, two hard columns.
options.viewport: One tall sheet: STEFANO DOKO in mixed wood type over an engraved band of his two businesses.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with a designer who prints; holds on clarity, but Albanian business owners do not know the form.
options.risk: Reads as costume if the engraving turns into clip-art.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.thesis: The portfolio as a game screen of fat pixels and phosphor glow.
options.viewport: A score bar with STEFANO DOKO in pixel caps over a tiled playfield.
options.case: Loses both axes: business owners do not hire a designer from an arcade.
options.kept: Palette law: each colour reserved for one state.
options.risk: Reads as a game studio, not a designer for businesses.

options.label: Step Sequencer
options.thesis: The portfolio as a sixteen-step row under a running chase light.
options.viewport: A charcoal panel with sixteen candy keys; each project is a pattern bank.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful for musicians, off-subject for business owners.
options.kept: One unbroken line with a light that always says where now is.
options.risk: Toy-like; the work would hide behind the instrument.

options.label: Paper Automata
options.thesis: The portfolio as a cranked procession of folded paper figures.
options.viewport: A crank line along the base; each project a paper figure that unfolds.
options.case: Loses both axes: charming, but it says craft fair, not business design.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the figure currently in motion.

options.label: Stage Cyclorama
options.thesis: The portfolio lit like a stage from night to day.
options.viewport: A black stage; a cobalt horizon rises and the name appears in dawn light.
options.case: Loses both axes: atmospheric, but nothing an owner recognises.
options.kept: Named, linkable states along a cue timeline.

options.label: Skate Deck Wall
options.thesis: The portfolio as a rack of decks you pull and flip.
options.viewport: A wall of tall decks; each project flips from grip black to full art.
options.case: Loses both axes: the wrong street for business owners.
options.kept: Logotypes built to survive scale-down to sticker size.
options.risk: Youth-brand costume on a business service.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A designer portfolio as everyone ships it: big name, work grid, about, contact.
canonCard.viewport: A huge name top-left, a grid of project thumbnails, a Let's talk button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other designer's site, by design.
